Hi Rishi / Neha —

Looping you in for approval guidance. Enterprisecorp is asking for:

- SLA: 99.9% uptime requirement for production routes (they prefer contractual language).
- Pricing: looking for committed Dedicated pricing with an ask for a 20% first-year discount tied to a 12-month commit.
- Contract timeline: CFO expects to sign by end of December; security will run a standard questionnaire and wants SOC 2 artefacts.

Why I'm asking: 99.9% SLA is higher than our standard hosted SLA & requires Dedicated with redundancy and a potential SLA credit schedule; the 20% discount is outside standard pricing approval for this segment.

Proposed internal approvals requested from you: 
1) Approve SLA exception to support 99.9% with the following constraints: require Dedicated deployment, cross-AZ redundancy, and a higher penalty cap of 3x credits only if revenue threshold met.
2) Approve a one-time flexibility to offer up to 20% discount for year-one on committed Dedicated seats contingent on signed 12-month contract and minimum ARR of $125k.

Attachments: Draft_SOW_Enterprisecorp_v1.docx; Procurement-MAAP.xlsx (procurement intake)

Please advise if you need additional margin sensitivity or legal/engineering sign-off. We need a reply by EOD Fri (20 Nov) to keep the timeline.

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear ask and the context. After quick sync with finance and legal:

1) SLA: Approved conditionally. You can agree to 99.9% uptime in contract if we include (a) Dedicated deployment requirement, (b) cross-AZ redundancy plan documented in SOW, and (c) SLA credit cap limited to three months of fees and limited to incidents where Redwood control is primary cause. Engineering should sign off on the redundancy design before contract execution.

2) Discount: Approved up to 20% for year one, contingent on 
   - Signed 12-month committed Dedicated contract, and
   - Minimum ARR guarantee of $125k, and
   - Legal to review modified indemnity/terms (procurement change).

Neha, please kick off the legal review on the indemnity language and confirm that the capped credit language is acceptable. Marissa, once legal signs off, proceed to send the updated SOW and pricing table to Claire and procurement.
